name: Feed the Reactor
hint: Space cuts; 1/2 choose ropes; touch swipes cut. Deliver three batteries.
description: Swing a battery into a hungry reactor; original anchors, gates and geometry.

name: Neon Rhythm Escape
hint: Tap or Space on the metronome click to clear spikes and gaps.
description: Paint waveform course with original metronome music, jump arcs and checkpoint-free short rounds.

name: Skyline Jumper
hint: Arrows or held touch halves steer automatic jumps.
description: Armored jumper climbs rooftop ledges; wind and crumbling platforms add original route choices.

name: Turbo Flapper
hint: Tap or Space to flap. Collect three cells for a shield.
description: Original cape glider crosses ink arches; this is a longer scored run distinct from existing three-gate Flappy Bonus.

name: Bridge Builder
hint: Hold touch or Space to grow; release to lower the plank.
description: Grow telescoping scrap planks between rooftop chimneys; gaps and landing widths vary.

name: Reactor Merge
hint: Swipe or arrows slide tiles; U undo and R reset.
description: Reactor energy board with a short target and optional continued play; original artwork.

name: Rooftop Defense
hint: 1/2/3 selects; arrows + Space builds, or tap card then tile.
description: Deploy battery generators, bolt turrets and barricades against original rooftop machines.

name: Mini Reactor Buddy
hint: 1-4 selects care; Space acts. PLAY needs timing inside green.
description: A tiny friendly reactor needs fuel, polishing and play; complete a short care request without real-time neglect penalties.
